name: The Little Mermaid

crownPassive.name: Turning tide
crownPassive.text: Every enemy bond that gives a number is reversed: +1 Attack becomes -1 Attack, +1 Guard becomes -1 Guard, +1 Speed becomes -1 Speed, +1 to healing becomes -1 to healing, and so on. Bonds without a number work as normal.

bond.name: Sea foam
bond.text: When she dies, your other Eventyr heroes heal 3.

actions.name: Sea magic
actions.text: A Spell for her Attack on any enemy card. She takes 1 damage, ignoring Guard.

actions.name: Saved from the wreck
actions.text: Heal 4 to each of your heroes.

rules: Floors under Turning tide: an attack's final damage is never below 0, Speed never below 1, Guard never below 0, and a heal never below 0. A reversed Health bond lowers maximum Health but can't drop a card below 1, so it never deals damage.
Turning tide reverses penalties too: an enemy bond of -1 becomes +1. Against Baba Yaga it turns her -1 Speed and -2 Health into +1 Speed and +2 Health for her side.
notes: Her attack cost is the knives in her feet. After Nightfall she can't heal, so each attack really costs her.
